title: Baseline Assessment: Mapping working conditions and child labor in Nestlé's cocoa supply chain in Cameroon
methodology: Baseline assessment conducted in March and April 2020 across three cooperatives and six cocoa-producing communities supplying a Nestlé tier-1 supplier; interviews, farm visits and review of supplier systems.
limitations: Historical and geographically limited assessment. The FLA states it did not encounter child labour on the farms visited, while identifying risk indicators and monitoring gaps. Nestlé ended its membership as an FLA Participating Company in April 2025; this does not by itself establish the current status of all monitoring systems.
